LA1_pullback.statement: J10(tau2, dn) = J_pop_EW(sigma(tau2, dn), eta(tau2, dn)) exactly; J_pop_EW = Pi_WW^2 + det(Pi_neutral)^2 + (tr(Pi_neutral)/2 + eta_source)^2, and on the chart Pi_WW = tau2

LA1_seam_pump.statement: the pump is the identity on span{|00>, |11>, |+>} with every other Kraus branch zero there; it acts only on the disagreement components |->, |20>, |02>

LA4_i_projection.statement: with the coarse moment as the only emitted moment, the multipliers of the fine deformation features vanish and their means stay at the reference value 0; a nonzero mean needs an emitted moment on that feature

LA5_z6_traces.statement: the Z6 centre acts trivially on every Standard-Model field and on every gauge adjoint, so the invariant projector is the identity (normalized trace 1) on the vacuum-polarization chart on which the D10 transport acts; the trace 1/6 of the C10 carrier is the trace on the regular register, which the D10 transport does not carry
